title: DNA Genetic Sequence Alignment
description: Biologists are comparing two DNA strands represented as strings of characters. They want to measure the genetic similarity by finding the length of the longest common subsequence present in both strands. A subsequence is a string that appears in the same relative order, but not necessarily contiguously.
constraints: text1 and text2 consist of only lowercase English characters.
output_format: An integer representing the length of their longest common subsequence.

examples.explanation: The longest common subsequence is "ace" with length 3.
The longest common subsequence is "abc" with length 3.
There is no common subsequence, so the result is 0.
